mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Aurora sends out a pulse of spirit energy that deals @DamageCalc@ damage.

The area merges with the spirit realm for @DurationTotal@ seconds, giving Aurora the ability to travel from one end of the area to the other by crossing the threshold, dealing @KnockTotalDmg@ damage and knocking nearby enemies on arrival.

Aurora can Recast the ability to end the effect early.

Aurora enters the spirit realm, becoming Invulnerable for @TotalDuration@s.

During this effect, Aurora will apply Hexed and deal @PassthroughDmg@ damage to all enemies she comes into contact with.
Every @LevelsNeededforSpirit@ levels Aurora calls a spirit that follows her around. Spirits will damage, slow, and apply <keywordMajor>Hexed</keywordMajor> to enemies they get near to.
